content:
Priya: Heads-up, two docs PRs need reviewers today -> migration guide (GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412) and SDK snippets examples (GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/419). Can folks pick these up before EOD?

Marco: I can take the migration guide. planning to skim and leave inline TODOs first.

Priya: thanks Marco — FYI preview for #412 is failing so might be a quick follow-up commit needed.

devex-bot: preview created for PR #412 but build failed (netlify). Log: `render-error: mermaid diagram parse failed`

Marco: ugh, saw that. The mermaid block in the migration guide is missing a closing ``` and breaks the renderer.

Daniel: if it's just a missing fence we can do a tiny commit. Want me to push a fix and tag Marco to re-run preview?

Irene: I can take the SDK snippets PR (#419) — looks like examples for Python/TS and one missing code fence in the TS example too.

alex: quick reminder — we should not merge until docs-preview shows green link + Netlify preview works. Last time a merge broke the production nav.

Priya: Agreed. Merge window tomorrow 12:00-14:00 PT but smaller fixes ok before if previews pass.

Daniel: Pushing a 1-line fix to close the mermaid fence now. Will tag Marco.

Daniel: commit pushed -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/aa11bb22cc

devex-bot: Re-run triggered for PR #412. New preview URL: https://deploy-preview-412--docs.redwood.ai

devex-bot: Build succeeded for PR #412. Status: preview ready ✅

Marco: reviewed the migration guide, left a suggestion on the rollout example (small wording). Approving after that.

Irene: started on #419, added a comment about adding a short note for `npm i @redwood/sdk` vs `pip install redwood-sdk`. Also fixed the fenced code block in the TS snippet and pushed.

Priya: thanks all. Can someone add `@docs-team` as reviewer in CODEOWNERS for the SDK snippets folder? We keep missing ownership when someone is OOO.

Daniel: done — added `docs/sdk/* @docs-team` to CODEOWNERS in a follow-up commit -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/bb22cc33dd

alex: nit: let's also add a small checklist in the PR template to verify preview URL + run local `make docs-preview` step. Avoids these manual pings.

Priya: good idea. Alex, can you draft the PR template change? small bullet points.

alex: will open a tiny PR for template later today.

Marco: FYI after addressing my wording nit, I will approve and we can merge in the maintenance window tomorrow if nothing else pops up.

Irene: SDK snippets LGTM from me. Approving.

Priya: Summary: Marco -> migration guide (#412) (approved after nit). Irene -> SDK snippets (#419) (approved). Daniel -> quick fix for mermaid and CODEOWNERS. Alex -> PR template change. Merge window tomorrow 12-14 PT. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Marco: cheers.

Irene: thanks!

devex-bot: Reminder scheduled: docs merge window tomorrow 12:00 PT -> slack reminder set for #docs.
